artifact_observations.reasoning: The bottom-most white leaf charm appears physically impossible; the loop connecting it to the chain seems to merge into the body of the leaf without a distinct ring, and the leaf shape itself warps/melts at the bottom edge, lacking rigid structural integrity.

artifact_observations.location: Junction of black beads and gold chain
artifact_observations.reasoning: The connection points between the black faceted beads and the gold-tone wire/chain are indistinct, appearing slightly fused or melted rather than mechanically linked by jump rings.
The internal texture of the white leaves is overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the subtle surface imperfections or refraction variations expected in real glass or resin.

To rigorously check the connectivity of the lower-left leaf which appears to have a melted/fused attachment point.
To verify if the overlapping chains and beads have consistent depth ordering and do not bleed into each other.
To assess the realism of reflections on the metal and translucency of the stones.
